# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a mobile-first browser game called **Tiny Goblin Ringfall**. Preserve a real-time node-conquest loop: the player selects a start node, then drags from owned nodes to adjacent nodes to send half the units; nodes produce over time; moving units reinforce allies or damage/capture enemies; AI factions do the same; capturing a capital annexes that faction; the player wins by owning all enemy nodes and loses by having no nodes/troops. Rebuild presentation around `Create a deterministic creative remix in a Halo inspired style, centered on a goblin gremlin, but make it tiny. Preserve the core playable mechanic loop while rebuilding the theme, identity, surface art, world language, and presentation around this new premise.`: a tiny armored goblin gremlin named Pip-Squeak hijacks shield plates on an ancient sci-fi ringworld. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art: orbital arcs, shield cells, goblin-green armor, cyan conduits, purple plasma, gold crown shards, tiny courier sparks, compact HUD, catalog fonts/audio, and mobile-safe controls.

# Blueprint

## Current implemented game identity
- genre: real-time node conquest strategy on a connected graph.
- objective: select a starting command zone, send half of a node's units along adjacent links, capture every opposing node, and avoid losing all owned nodes/troops.
- input model: pointer/touch selects a starting node; during play pointer-drag from an owned node to an adjacent node dispatches half its count; buttons control jammer/peace cooldown, speed, pause, music, restart.
- core loop: nodes produce units up to a devastation-modified cap, mobile troops travel along edges, impacts reinforce friendly nodes or subtract hostile counts, depleted targets flip ownership, AI periodically sends half-stacks from enemy nodes, capital capture annexes a faction, win occurs when no enemies remain.
- fail/friction state: invalid drags are blocked; AI pressure and production caps create attrition; loss occurs when player has no owned nodes and no player troops.

## Protected mechanics
- Graph topology, node polygon hit testing, adjacency-only dispatch, half-count troop sending, travel speed, production cadence, capacity/devastation behavior, faction annex on capital capture, AI periodic dispatch, jammer duration/cooldown, speed-cycle values, pause/restart/win/loss state flow.
- Touch and pointer semantics remain scoped to the canvas so HUD buttons keep native click/tap behavior.
- Score/progress remains represented by node ownership and unit counts rather than a new scoring system.

## Remixed target
Tiny Goblin Ringfall is a deterministic ringworld skirmish: a palm-sized goblin gremlin in sci-fi armor hijacks miniature outposts across an ancient orbital ring. The mechanics remain node-conquest strategy, while territories become shield plates, troops become tiny gremlin clones, the peace ability becomes a bubble-jammer, capitals become shard crowns, and annex/win/failure copy uses coherent ringworld gremlin language.
